nuclearpoultry.name: The Longest Text Page
nuclearpoultry.description: Written by NuclearPoultry. Made using a strange website builder and still up after all these years

redacted-name.name: [REDACTED NAME]'s LTE
redacted-name.description: Originally hosted on a Geocities mirror service before it got taken down. Archive has been redacted of personal information upon the original author's request.

1.name: RainbowFluffySheep's LoTeEv (Part 1)
1.description: Currently the first result that shows when you Google 'longest text ever'. Also doesn't follow the LTE acronym, instead making one of their own. Silly you!

2.name: RainbowFluffySheep's LoTeEv (Part 2)
2.description: The second part to the RainbowFluffySheep saga.

whiletrue.name: WhileTrue's LTE
whiletrue.description: One of the more recognizable LTEs, used across the internet in various places. Original author has taken down the live version, but you know us! Always archivin'!

mckenzie.name: Mckenzie's LTE
mckenzie.description: Written by howds. Well here's a familar face!

iseycupcake.name: Iseycupcake's LTE
iseycupcake.description: An inoffensive LTE, not much else to say.

busterddog.name: BusterDdog's Kinda Boring Life
busterddog.description: One of the few LTEs to not directly label itself as an LTE. Submitted due to affiliation with Pink Pickle.

kaixiogd.name: KaixioGD's Longest Text EVERRRRR
kaixiogd.description: Discovered recently, which is strange since it was made in 2021...

textra.name: Textra LTE
textra.description: Had a scuffed attempt of ASCII art as a header. Live version has been deleted; use the archive.

knockton.name: Knockton's Potato LTE
knockton.description: The once-crowned first place of the list, now dethroned. Their use of JSON to store their entries inspired the internal workings of this list!

monika.name: The Book of Monika
monika.description: Mentions they're a representative of 'Monika'. Which Monika? We may never know... Was originally hosted as a text file. Live version has been deleted; use the archive.

of2019.name: 大円三とわはＳＭＭ's LTE
of2019.description: One of the first LTEs to be directly submitted, and the first on this list to use Google Docs as a medium of distribution.

slashii.name: Slashii LTE
slashii.description: This one has an eye for detail. That's all I'll say

falconslte.name: Falcon XWPlays's LTE
falconslte.description: Very similar in design to the Slashii LTE. Coincidence? Eh, maybe.

ltea.name: 'lteaaaaaaa'
ltea.description: Another weird one. Also the shortest on the list. Why did we even list this

spice04.name: spice04's LTE
spice04.description: not danish also known as dansk. Archive leads to a version with previously deleted text at 116,709 characters.

dfc454.name: dfc454's LTE of stupidity
dfc454.description: Might live up to the name (joking! joking!) There are two iterations interestingly, however the archived iteration will only count towards placement. Affiliated with Ohnkata and sprout.

ohnkata.name: whyislands LTE of the
ohnkata.description: The current first place of the list. It is... it is... great words from the magic man. It's absurd how much this guy writes I cannot even fathom it. Introduced a lot of the newer LTE writers to the list.

sprout.name: sprout's LTE of drugs
sprout.description: Another Google Docs LTE. There are some non-English elements and dysfunctional rambling throughout, as is usual for a typical LTE. Affiliated with Ohnkata and dfc454.

sslink.name: sslink's spinning LTE
sslink.description: Yet another Google Docs LTE. A fun read

longtext.name: 'My LTE'
longtext.description: Strange little LTE. Author has no known name as the Neocities username seems to pertain solely to the task of being an LTE.

misc544.name: Misc Practice's Longest Text Ever
misc544.description: Originally being an LTE hosted on Fandom Wiki of all places, a successor was published on Neocities with excerpts from their original LTE pieced in.

jaiden2013.name: The Land Walrus LTE
jaiden2013.description: Originally being the previous first place before Ohnkata and after Knockton, this LTE has been defined as untrue by our standards due to violations of rules 3, 4, 9, and 10.

cyanbyte.name: Cy's LTE
cyanbyte.description: Submittion through email. Has a unique matrix-like website theme.

ricky.name: Ricky's LTE
ricky.description: There sure are a lot of these Google Docs LTEs, huh? Affiliated with Ohnkata.

stlepsy.name: Maple's No Lifer Project
stlepsy.description: This one takes a geographical theme in terms of the content of entries. Affiliated with Ohnkata.

1.name: Shade's (old) LTE!
1.description: Originally hosted on Angelfire before that died. Luckily, we were able to snag a copy just before it all came crashing down!

2.name: Shade's Revolutions LTE
2.description: The sequel(?) to their old LTE, now hosted on Neocities!

farragofiction.name: FarragoFiction LTE
farragofiction.description: The spiritual successor to the Flaming Chicken's LTE. Text is scrombled on page load, so you'll need to go digging for the source text file to try to make any sense of it.

sourtoastcrunch.name: Sourtoastcrunch's very cool LTE
sourtoastcrunch.description: This LTE had been defined as untrue due to poor conduct from the author.
